text_block_list.text:
To make Still in Love stronger without awakening her instincts—
Some time had passed since I made that resolve.

text_block_list.name: Free-running Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Hm, so you're my opponent today?
...Hmph...
"To get used to controlling her instincts, she chose to enter a freestyle race swirling with fighting spirit—an unofficial street race."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: I-I look forward to working with you...

text_block_list.name: Free-running Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Haha, are you gonna be okay being so timid?
Our races get pretty rough, you know!

text_block_list.name: Free-running Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Do be careful that you don't get hurt, at the very least—
wont you, little lady?

Telling the anxious girl not to overdo it...
I ask her to be mindful of suppressing her instincts, no matter how much her heart aches.
choice_data_list: Sorry, I know this must be tough on you, but...
I'm sorry, I know it's painful, but...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...I'm fine.
If this is what you wish... I..."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Still, it might already... be too late.
choice_data_list: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Because—it looks so delicious.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Haaaaaaaaah...
ーーAaaahahahahahaaa!!

text_block_list.name: Free-running Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: ...Wh-!? Wh-What is with her...!? Sh-She's too fast...!!
choice_data_list: (No way, her sharpness is even better than before...?!)
(No way, her sharpness has gotten even sharper...?!)

text_block_list.text:
Perhaps stirred by the fighting spirit swirling through the racecourse,
her instincts were indeed unleashed... Yet, whether because she was in peak condition today,
she was simply—overwhelmingly strong.
choice_data_list: (Ah, just as I thought... —so beautiful)

text_block_list.name: Free-running Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
U... Uwaaaaaagh!!
N-No! Stay away!

—Before anyone realized, she had begun the hunt.
Charging at the pack ahead with more ferocity than ever.
Perhaps shaken by this, the Umamusume's movements fell into disarray...!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
What's the matter!? Hurry... *hurry*...
Come right here! Right up to—my throat!

text_block_list.name: Free-running Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...!
W-We're gonna crash...!!
choice_data_list: Still...!! Slow down!!

text_block_list.text: I was frantic. Before the accident could happen, I tried to jump out and stop Still in Love—

text_block_list.name: Observing Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Seriously... what on earth are you doing?!
Didn't you learn in kindergarten not to jump out
in front of a running Umamusume?!
choice_data_list: I'm really sorry...
I'm truly sorry...

text_block_list.name: Observing Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Seriously... Good thing I stopped you!
Were you trying to ruin our precious place?!
...I've memorized your faces, got it?!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Trainer...
I'm so sorry, it's all my fault...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I tried to suppress it.
But... no matter what, my heart keeps fluttering...
choice_data_list: I'm the one who should be sorry. ...Shall we head back now?
I'm the one who should apologize. ...Shall we go home now?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
...Ah...

text_block_list.name: Observers
text_block_list.text:
"...Hey, that Trainer is something else, but...
Isn't that girl... kinda crazy?"

text_block_list.name: Free-running Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*... What is with her...?
I-I never want to run with her ever again...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: (I've caused Trainer such trouble... Why did I...)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: (...Why? Why is it that only I... end up like this?)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: (—I just want to disappear...)
As we head back to the academy together, I reflect on what just happened. It was my naive underestimation that put Still in Love in danger.
choice_data_list: Still. I'm really sorry about today--
Still. I'm really sorry about today--

text_block_list.text:
When I looked back,
she was nowhere to be found.
choice_data_list: Huh? Still...? Still!

text_block_list.text:
Panic sets in for a moment... but I need to calm down and think rationally.
There's no doubt she was hurt in that last race. That's why she disappeared all by herself—
choice_data_list: (I've got to find it...!)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
choice_data_list: (Ouch...!)

text_block_list.text:
After searching everywhere,
it was finally evening
by the time I found her...
choice_data_list: ...I feel like I'm always searching for you.
...It feels like I'm always looking for you.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"H-How did you...?
How did you know this place...?"
choice_data_list: "Just intuition!" ...would've sounded cool, but

text_block_list.text: In truth, I just frantically searched every place I could think of. I felt miserable for making her spend time feeling so anxious and alone, but—
choice_data_list: I want to share your pain and your anxieties... together.
I want to share your pain and your worries... together

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...I can't take this anymore.
Being like this..."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"Every Umamusume harbors a fighting spirit...
an instinct within them. And yet..."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"I'm the only 'monster' like this.
I'm the only one who's... so hideous..."
choice_data_list: No. I told you before, didn't I? You're beautiful.
No. Didn't I tell you before? You are beautiful.

text_block_list.text: True, her form might be different from others. But that's precisely why... I find myself so drawn to her.

To her insatiable fighting spirit seeking out the strong.
To her beast-like, ferocious running brimming with life.
To both sides of her—reason and instinct.
choice_data_list: Everyone's different... That's all there is to it
Everyone's different... That's all there is to it

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
choice_data_list: There's no way I could just agree to that. But...
There's no way I could just agree to that. But...

text_block_list.text: Even if you can't accept or affirm everything about yourself, that's okay. But being able to do nothing but deny yourself... is just so sad.
choice_data_list: You have the courage to never give up... You'll be fine.
You have the courage to never give up... You'll be okay

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Trainer...
choice_data_list: ...I'm okay. I'm okay...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
*Hic*... *sniff*...
...ngh, ugh...—
...Looks nice and warm.
—She is... different from me.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
('Let's do our best to suppress those instincts.'
That's what Trainer said, but...)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Stop. ...I know.
I know that won't be enough... to win.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...No, anything but that...
I mean, looking so unladylike...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
“—I don't want to expose any more of this...
in front of that person...!”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Heh.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me.
...It was just so utterly ridiculous.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Nghh!!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Mejiro... Ramonu...-san.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Your running... no,
"your" running style... I've seen it somewhere before.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
A beast. And a top-notch one at that...
Splendid, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
!
W-What are you saying—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Why are you ashamed?
Why do you hesitate?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Why do you fear?
—When I love you so.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
!!!!
L-Love, you say... Th-That's not...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...If it is only that much.
Your precious thing...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Perhaps I'll take that innocent heart as well...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Gh-gh-gh-gh!!!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
...Oh.
That look on your face—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text: Isn't that just lovely?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—Schemes and trickery.
How undesirable.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Peeking, huh...
I wonder which one is more improper...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Because you seemed unusually amused.
And sure enough... honestly.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You shouldn't toy with the hearts of others on a whim.
You ought to know that doing so can warp even destiny itself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Oh?
Are you talking about yourself?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
If it changes so easily, then perhaps
it was meant to be that way from the start.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ramonu
text_block_list.text:
Giggle...
I wonder what colors that love will paint next.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I won't hand them over.
Not that person, of all people...

The next day, I received a message from Still in Love
saying she wanted to talk.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: —I want to stop holding back the power of my instincts.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: "...Truth be told, I knew it all along. That I couldn't keep going like this if I wanted to become stronger."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: “However, no matter what…… I just didn't want to show that state of myself……”
choice_data_list: That's true. But then, why...?
That's true. But then, why...?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
“—It is so that I can achieve the Triple Tiara.
Without fail...”

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: If it's for that... I'll use any means necessary...
choice_data_list: ...Still?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...This is something I absolutely will not yield...
I cannot afford to give up."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
That's why... I will summon my courage.
—In order to win.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: I will... unleash my instincts.
choice_data_list: ...You know it's going to get tougher than this, right?
...You know it's going to get tougher than this, right?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Yes.
choice_data_list: ...Alright. Then I've made up my mind, too.
...Alright. Then I've made up my mind, too.

text_block_list.text: She made her decision. In that case, I will put all my intellect to work to bring her instincts under complete control. And then—
choice_data_list: —If anything happens, I swear I'll protect you this time.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
I'm looking forward to working with you...!
